newsitem.title: CHINA: China flies flag at half-mast for Deng's death.
newsitem.headline: China flies flag at half-mast for Deng's death.

text.p: China raised its national flag to half-mast in a solemn flag-raising ceremony in Tiananmen Square in the heart of Beijing to mourn the death of paramount leader Deng Xiaoping.

The bright red flag emblazoned with five gold stars was raised by a soldier of the People's Liberation Army who marched up to the flagpole in a squad with bayonets at their shoulders from the Forbidden City that housed China's emperors.
Early morning bystanders in the square showed scant reaction, many unaware that Deng had died, and photograph stall holders were putting up their stands.
State radio and television announced the death and played funereal music with television showing a black and white photograph of Deng against a blue background.
